caption:
CAM (Common Area Maintenance) charges let owners recover shared building operating expenses from tenants; reconciliations ensure actual costs match what tenants paid. This lesson covers what is typically included versus excluded, how allocations are calculated, and practical steps to reduce disputes. Review lease language for defined CAM items, allocation bases, audit rights, and any caps or amortization rules. Require line-item invoices and vendor backup, maintain a consistent chart of accounts, and provide timely reconciliations. In Chester and Montgomery counties, track seasonal services like snow removal and landscaping and document vendor contracts. Need templates, lease review help, or a reconciliation checklist? For tailored guidance and resources, visit dmsellscre.com/investors.
